entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
He has sought his release on
bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.

According to the FIR, the victim, a young girl, was found missing from her house from 27.11.2023,
at 7:30 PM.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim, her father, who is the informant,
and her mother, all have been examined at trial.
They have not supported the prosecution case.

Reference has been made to Annexure No.4 to the bail application, wherein, the statement of PW1,
the victim, and other witnesses are enclosed.
The victim has not supported the prosecution case.
PW2, the father of the victim, has told that he does not know as to with whom the victim had left her home.
PW3, the mother of the victim, has not stated anything against the applicant.
5. Learned State Counsel admits that the victim, her father and mother all have not supported the prosecution case.
He would submit that the forensic report is still awaited.
6. Having considered, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

7. The bail application is allowed.
